title: Oscar and the Letters
author: Vesper Pemberton
blurb: Rosalind Lockridge, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
